newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China construction contractor eyes A share offer.
newsitem.headline: China construction contractor eyes A share offer.

text.p: China construction contractor Zhejiang Guangsha Construction Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 35 million A shares, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
The company expects to launch the issue in March and to list the stock in Shanghai, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Guangdong-based Guangfa Securities Co Ltd has been appointed as the main underwriter for the offer, the official said.
Guangsha, based in Hangzhou, capital of eastern Zhejiang province, would use share proceeds to renovate its construction equipment and finance a building materials project, he said.
Guangsha, which is currently constructing a 63-floor office building in central Hunan province, estimated 1996 net earnings at 55 million yuan, the official said but gave no comparative figures.
The company has 105 million outstanding shares, consisting of 84 million legal person shares and 21 million staff shares, the official said.
